mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(username, password, email,status) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{email},1)
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND password = #{password} AND status = 1
SELECT username,email, gender, address, birthday FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, address = #{address} WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1
